name: [RELEASE] Anime Battle Tycoon
desc:
Welcome to Anime Battle Simulator!
👍NOMU HAS ARRIVED! New code at 45k likes!

💀 Fight bosses and unlock Secret Boss Companions!
🌎 Explore immersive worlds with beautiful designs!

1 NEW World - Hero High 
1 NEW Hero - Dragon Slayer
NEW Stats menu - shows totals data 
2 NEW Prisms [Hero Prism + Premium]
+10 NEW Companions [+3 Hidden, Secret companions] 
Midzone Walls - Worlds are split in 2, based on level
Companion rarity change + secret in every prism
Skill Points are removed, leveling increases hero stats

"Old Man" is now limited, no longer obtainable
Companions max level increased to 70 or 75]
LOTS of bug fixes, see patch notice for more
